name: Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-Pulse

benchmarks.note: Measured on an idle NVIDIA GB10 with llama-speculative-simple, temperature 0, --ignore-eos, 1854-token code prompt. Nothing here is extrapolated. See https://github.com/usmaneth/pulse/blob/main/bench/RESULTS.md

corrections: An earlier manifest claimed 141.28 tok/s single-stream, 206.50 peak, 0.021 ms GDN restore and 495.20 aggregate tok/s across 16 subagents. Those were not measured and have been replaced with measured values.
